\begin{document}
Energies are measured from the chemical potential,
\begin{equation}
G(\omega) = \frac{1}{\omega - \epsilon}, \qquad \epsilon \equiv \epsilon - \mu .
\label{eq:g}
\end{equation}
The spectral weight is normalized,
\begin{equation}
\frac{1}{\omega-\epsilon} - \frac{1}{\omega+\epsilon} = \frac{2\epsilon}{\omega^2-\epsilon^2} .
\label{eq:pp}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
